headword: {影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える
reading: えいきょうをあたえる
gloss: to have an influence; to affect

definitions.gloss: to have an influence on; to affect; to impact
definitions.explanation: To exert influence or produce an effect on something or someone. Can refer to both positive and negative effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えるだろう。
examples.english: This policy will likely have a significant impact on the economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すく}なから→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ず{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えるものだ。
examples.english: Parents' words and actions inevitably have a considerable influence on their children's development.

notes:
A highly common expression combining ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (influence, effect) with ⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to give). The person or thing being influenced takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — A affects B / A has an influence on B

COMMON MODIFIERS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a big impact
- ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a bad influence
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a good influence
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a serious impact

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to influence (more concise but slightly less natural in many contexts)
- ⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす→影響を及ぼす：16547_eikyouwooyobosu⟧ — to exert influence (more formal and written)
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to sway, to influence decisively

USAGE:
This is the standard way to say "to affect" or "to influence" in Japanese. The passive form ⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける→影響を受ける：25023_eikyouwoukeru⟧ (to be influenced, to be affected) is its natural counterpart for the receiving side.
